intent: Claude Companion server: an always-on Bun service on each host (Mac, Zettlab) that turns Claude Code hook calls into a curated phone experience — approvals, questions and dialogs routed to the iPhone, live activity and feed over WebSocket, keystroke injection back into tmux sessions, and the single-thread orchestrator that dispatches worker sessions. Clients: the native iOS app (primary), the React PWA (desktop), and other companion hosts. Correctness bar: a hook must never block Claude longer than the phone takes to answer; every frame shape is a contract with a shipped iOS build.
